AutisticCognition.texto: The system processes information by prioritizing local sensory detail over global coherence, operating through concrete-visual representations as the primary format, requiring explicit rule structures to navigate social and procedural contexts, and regulating learning exclusively through predictable, closed-loop, low-ambiguity feedback

NeurotypicalCognition.texto: The system integrates multiple sensory and social channels simultaneously through automatic relevance filtering, processes from concrete to abstract across developmental stages, infers implicit social norms through immersive participation, and generalizes learned rules automatically across structurally distinct contexts
NeurotypicalCognition processes multiple contextual cues about the unfamiliar peer simultaneously

hub.texto: AutisticCognition processes each mind-change as separate disconnected sensory events

solution.proposed_solution: Create a Sequential Sensory Bridge System that transforms complex multi-channel information into discrete, ordered sensory events while preserving the essential contextual information that neurotypical cognition processes simultaneously. This system acts as a translation interface that maintains information integrity across both cognitive processing styles.

components.description: Sensory Event Sequencer - Breaks down simultaneous multi-channel inputs into ordered, discrete sensory packets with explicit timestamps and priority markers
components.mechanism: Uses buffering algorithms to capture simultaneous inputs, then releases them as sequential events with preserved relational metadata. Each event contains: primary sensory data, context tags, and explicit connection markers to related events.

components.description: Predictable Pattern Framework - Establishes consistent, rule-based structures for how sensory events are sequenced and connected
components.mechanism: Implements fixed algorithms for event ordering (temporal, spatial, intensity-based) with explicit documentation of sequencing rules. Provides closed-loop feedback confirming successful event processing.

components.description: Context Preservation Layer - Maintains implicit social and environmental cues as explicit metadata attached to each discrete sensory event
components.mechanism: Extracts contextual information from simultaneous processing and embeds it as structured data within each sequential event. Includes social norm indicators, environmental relevance scores, and cross-reference links.

components.description: Adaptive Reconstruction Interface - Allows neurotypical systems to reassemble sequential events back into simultaneous contextual understanding when needed
components.mechanism: Provides APIs and reconstruction algorithms that can rapidly combine sequential events back into multi-channel simultaneous processing format, preserving original contextual relationships.

solution.verification: Success is verified by: (1) Measuring information preservation - comparing input complexity to output completeness, (2) Testing processing compatibility - confirming both cognitive styles can successfully operate on the transformed data, (3) Monitoring feedback loops - ensuring predictable, low-ambiguity confirmation signals are generated, (4) Validating context retention - verifying that implicit social and environmental information remains accessible.
risks: Information bottleneck - Sequential processing may create delays that impact real-time social interactions
Metadata overhead - Explicit context preservation may create cognitive load rather than reducing it
Pattern rigidity - Fixed sequencing rules may not adapt well to novel or highly dynamic situations
Translation artifacts - The conversion process may introduce distortions not present in native processing
contingencies: If processing delays exceed acceptable thresholds, then implement parallel processing channels for high-priority sensory streams
If metadata becomes overwhelming, then provide configurable filtering options to adjust context detail levels
If sequencing patterns prove inadequate for novel situations, then implement learning algorithms to develop new pattern templates
If translation artifacts cause processing errors, then add validation layers to detect and correct conversion inconsistencies
